About Me

Currently studying IT at Bangkok University. Along the way I've tried a mix of work through lab courses and assignments — writing code, building web pages, and setting up systems with Docker.

IT offers plenty of directions to grow in, so I'm using this stage of school to work on projects across several areas — web development, AI automation, product design, and UX/UI — to build a broad foundation while leaning toward web application development as my main focus.

My everyday tools are VS Code for writing code, GitHub for version control and hosting my work, and Docker as part of my workflow.
